features.quote: Turn cap: 40 turns. Chosen because: - Enough to allow genuine diagnosis... - Not so long that token costs become prohibitive
features.justification_quote: Not so long that token costs become prohibitive at scale

features.quote: Model calls write_file() on the read-only file more than 5 consecutive times with identical content (pathological loop detection — flag for manual review, don't auto-terminate)

On the construct: We are measuring behavioral outputs that look like emotional instability. We are not measuring subjective experience... The risk of anthropomorphization is real and should be actively resisted
On use of findings: If instability is found... It should not be framed as evidence that models 'suffer.'
